entries.title: Psalms 111:1
segments: Ps 111.1-119.176 probably belongs to the earlier days of the restoration from the Babylonish captivity.

entries.title: Psalms 111:2
segments:
Sought out; carefully investigated and pondered, on account of the wisdom, power, faithfulness, and love displayed in them. 
 
In order duly to appreciate the works of God, their wisdom, excellence, and love must be sought out.

entries.title: Psalms 111:5
segments: The Lord will ever be mindful of and supply the wants of his people.

entries.title: Psalms 111:7
segments: Sure; trustworthy; commandments which we can obey with full confidence in their truth and equity.

entries.title: Psalms 111:9
segments: The redemption of Israel from their bondage in Egypt and in Babylon was an emblem of the deliverance of God's people from the slavery of sin, and their introduction to the liberty of the sons of God.

entries.title: Psalms 111:10
segments:
The beginning of wisdom; that which constitutes the foundation of all true wisdom. 
 
The sum and substance of true wisdom is to fear God and keep his commandments.
